title: Toddler's tragic death from brain-destroying amoeba offers lessons for doctors
summary: Thirty days after his initial hospital visit, doctors performed a brain biopsy to try to find the cause of his condition. In 2010, doctors in Kentucky reported a case in a 2-year-old boy who survived.
